HX-240.name: HX-240 Standard Process Pump
HX-240.positioning: General industrial process pump for water and light chemical service.
HX-240.head: up to 62 m
HX-240.optional_seals: FKM up to 120°C; PTFE up to 140°C subject to application review
HX-240.maintenance: Routine inspection every 4,000 operating hours; seal inspection every 2,000 hours in hot chemical service
HX-240.use_cases: treated water, utility water, light chemicals, CIP return, general process transfer
HX-240.caution: For continuous operation above 90°C, standard EPDM seal is not recommended.

HX-300.name: HX-300 High-Pressure Process Pump
HX-300.positioning: High-pressure process pump for demanding industrial transfer duties.
HX-300.head: up to 105 m
HX-300.optional_seals: PTFE up to 150°C; double mechanical seal available
HX-300.use_cases: high-pressure utility service, chemical transfer, filtration feed, process circulation
HX-300.caution: Not intended for hygienic/sterile service without validated cleaning design.

HX-400.name: HX-400 High-Temperature Heavy-Duty Pump
HX-400.positioning: Heavy-duty pump for high-temperature, high-pressure continuous process duties.
HX-400.head: up to 128 m
HX-400.optional_seals: PTFE up to 160°C; double mechanical seal and flush plan options
HX-400.materials: 316L stainless steel standard; duplex stainless steel optional
HX-400.maintenance: Routine inspection every 6,000 operating hours; every 3,000 hours for severe thermal cycling
HX-400.use_cases: hot process water, chemical circulation, thermal processes, high-pressure plant utilities
HX-400.caution: Above 130°C, PTFE seal configuration is required.

HX-520.name: HX-520 Hygienic CIP Pump
HX-520.positioning: Hygienic pump for food, beverage and pharmaceutical cleaning and process circuits.
HX-520.head: up to 70 m
HX-520.temp: 135°C continuous; 145°C for short sterilisation cycles up to 30 minutes
HX-520.optional_seals: FKM hygienic seal up to 140°C continuous
HX-520.solids: Not intended for abrasive solids; particles should remain below 1 mm
HX-520.maintenance: Hygienic seal inspection every 1,500 operating hours or per validated plant maintenance plan
HX-520.use_cases: CIP return, hygienic water, beverage process transfer, pharmaceutical utilities
HX-520.caution: Standard EPDM hygienic seal is not recommended above 125°C continuous.
